description: Intercom Messenger loader on widget.intercom.io/widget/{app_id}. Data events on api.intercom.io/events are vendor/intercom-events.

params.name: app_id
params.description: It is the Intercom workspace ID, also called App ID. Intercom documents the loader as `widget.intercom.io/widget/` plus that ID.
params.fix_hint: Put the workspace ID from the Intercom URL (`/a/apps/{id}/`) in the path as `/widget/{app_id}`.
